notes: Opt-in map from Mesh2Motion (M2M) source bone names to the frozen 50-bone 'polygon_humanoid' rig in the Godot project. Map keys are the M2M names expected in the exported GLB; map values are the Godot Skeleton3D bone names. A value of DROP means the source chain has no target (thumb_04_leaf, ring_* and pinky_* chains) and is discarded. The 10 bones listed in 'synthesize' have no M2M source and are added at rest in Godot (zero-length or authored rest offset). 40 mapped targets + 10 synthesized bones = the frozen 50-bone rig. Rig conventions: 1 unit = 1 m, Y up, -Z forward, feet at y=0, armature node 'Armature' with a 'Skeleton3D' child, animation track paths 'Armature/Skeleton3D:<bone>', root motion stripped. This profile is used by src.validate --profile to check joint names and by the Godot importer to rename bones.
